objects.name: Detection technique coverage: cloud-instance-modified-by-previously-unseen-user
objects.description: The following analytic identifies cloud instances being modified by users who have not previously modified them. It leverages data from the Change data model, focusing on successful modifications of EC2 instances. This activity is significant because it can indicate unauthorized or suspicious changes by potentially compromised or malicious users.
